whySoloBurstIIIIsTheCleanBasis: A solo Burst III unit makes ZERO full bursts — no Burst I exists to open the chain (the standing burst-eligibility fact). The bar therefore fills ONCE, monotonically, and then sits full: one uninterrupted generating window with no drain side, no chain zeroing, no FB gauge lock, and no rider/teammate credit to disentangle. Both traces show exactly that shape.

barGeometry.provenance: SELF-CALIBRATED independently on the scarlet clip (gauge-fill.py --calib-frame 600 over a crop=400:60:2222:470 frame set locked borderRow 31, x0 252, x1 390 in crop coords = 501 / 2474 / 2612 absolute). That is byte-identical to the solo bar geometry hand-verified on three DIFFERENT recordings on 2026-08-15 — an independent re-derivation of the HUD geometry on a separate recording session, not a reuse of the prior value.
barGeometry.drakeNote: Self-calibration MIS-LOCKED at 158px on the drake clip when the calib frame landed on her full GREEN bar; re-run with the explicit --bar escape hatch. Same failure class as the 2026-08-15 mis-lock note — always pass --bar, or a calib frame taken mid-FILL.

readings.AR: VALIDATED. scarlet's datamined targetPerTrigger 90 (0.90 %/shot) reproduces at 0.9199 %/shot bias-adjusted — ratio to column 1.0221, i.e. +2.2%. Read per MAGAZINE (20 rounds) because a 0.9 %/shot credit at 12 shots/s is below the reader's per-trigger resolution (one 0.72pp bar column per 1.25 shots at 30fps); the four magazine deltas are 20.3 / 19.5 / 18.9 / 19.6 pp, sd 0.57pp.
readings.SG: The per-trigger credit reads 0.847 of the datamined column, and is NOT CONSTANT. drake's datamined targetPerTrigger 900 (9.00 %/trigger, i.e. all 10 pellets landing) reads 7.6222 %/trigger bias-adjusted over 10 clean intra-magazine steps; individual steps run 6.5-9.4 raw. varianceRatio 10.02 = the step-to-step variance is ~10x what the bar's own column quantization permits.
readings.whatTheSGVarianceMeans: This is an INDEPENDENT MECHANICAL CORROBORATION of the U40 owner ruling (a missed SG pellet generates NO gauge; SG gauge credits per LANDED pellet). Under per-TRIGGER crediting every pull must credit the same value, so the only admissible step-to-step spread is reader quantization (varianceRatio ~1). Observed 10.02 refutes that directly, on an instrument — the gauge bar — that no prior SG work used. The mean ratio 0.847 is then the mean landed-pellet fraction over the window, which is a per-unit quantity, not a re-derivation of the datamined column.

controls.c1_cadence: drake's detected step gaps average 0.666s -> observedCadencePerSec 1.5015 vs her datamined rate_of_fire 90rpm = 1.5/s. The steps found ARE one-per-trigger, not merged or split.
controls.c2_magazineStructure: drake's first magazine is exactly 9 credited triggers (7.13-12.67s at 0.667s) = her datamined max_ammo 9, followed by a hard reload plateau. scarlet's plateau cycle is 4.275s vs her datamined 20 rounds / 12 per s + 2.30s reload = 3.967s, with the 0.31s remainder covered by her datamined spot_first_delay + spot_last_delay (20+20). Both weapons' ammo/cadence structure is reproduced from the trace alone, independent of the gauge question.
controls.c3_independentGeometry: see barGeometry.provenance — the 138px lock re-derived from scratch on this session's footage.
controls.c4_readerBias: Both numbers are divided by the committed rawOverTrue 1.064 (the maiden-ice-rose anchor bias carried in the trace's own calibration block), the same treatment the 2026-08-15 SMG/MG reads used.

caveats: n=1 recording per family; one unit per family. Neither is a class-wide claim.

drake is NOT in docs/probe-data/per-unit-sg-landing.json (which covers noir, isabel, guilty, brid-silent-track, dorothy-serendipity, soda-twinkling-bunny), so her 0.847 has no per-unit landing figure to be scored against; the four measured units' mid-band ratio-to-table spread is 0.92-1.00.

The drake window sits in the boss's opening 'mid' band (docs/data/range-data.md: starts mid, near at ~2:27), so this is a single-band read — the landing fraction is band-dependent by construction and no band comparison is available from one fill window.
The SG finding CORROBORATES an already-settled owner ruling; it enacts nothing and overturns nothing.
MEASUREMENT, not enactment: neither the AR nor the SG row is changed by this run.

postReviewNote.2026-08-17: Regenerated after the cross-family code review (qwen3.8-max-preview) added a SATURATION GUARD to soloMagRate (its sibling soloRate already had one) plus a cycleSdSec dispersion field. Every published number is BYTE-IDENTICAL — perMagRaw [20.3,19.5,18.9,19.6], perShotTrue 0.9199, ratioToColumn 1.0221 — because this window's plateaus top out at 89.9%, below the cap, so the new guard drops nothing here (saturatedPlateausDropped 0). The guard matters for FUTURE windows that run into the 100% cap; the reviewer verified the same before flagging it.
